desc:
🧠 Welcome to +1 Size to Grow Your Head!

How to Play:
🧱 Break walls with your head!
💥 Upgrade your Head Size to deal more damage!
🎩 Buy Hats that give powerful Head Size multipliers!
💸 Collect Brainrots and earn money from them!
💪 Upgrade your Carry capacity to collect more Brainrots!
⚡ Upgrade your Speed to move faster!
🔥 Break stronger walls and collect better brainrots!
🎉 Unlock new zones and encounter crazy events as you progress!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

🤩 Enjoy the game? Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ to support us!
